replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed firsthand perspective. Five years of actually living on St. Croix gives you a very different view from what most visitors ever see. The cost of living, utilities, healthcare access, shipping costs, and limited choices are serious issues that deserve to be part of the conversation alongside the island's beauty. I appreciate you sharing what your experience has been, and I truly hope things get easier for you and that better days are ahead. Sending you a big hug and wishing you strength through all of this. ❤️
